shouldFix.title: Two copied current-subject recitals still say v10 authors two prefix injections although its catalog authors one
shouldFix.claimUnderReview: The D-293 role says that two quoted CC-5 prefix injections exercise the delegated authority, and the current leftover-join role says g21-fixture-corpus.v10 authors both the exactly-at and far-over entries as prefix-only files.
primaryEvidence: The complete $.authoredCatalog.members array has length one and contains only G21.cc5.prefix-far-over-prehandshake. The fixture directory likewise contains exactly one regular 4-byte file, and its path set equals the catalog path set.

Top-level operative fields are internally consistent about the one-member result: $.registerRowNote and $.authorityClaim say one injection; $.purpose says v10 does not author an exactly-at member; $.whatIsAuthored says one catalog member and no exactly-at member; and $.summary reports authoredMembers 1 and authoredFiles 1.

$.basedOn.d293.role nevertheless retains the v9 sentence 'Two quoted CC-5 prefix injections exercise that delegation.' The v9-to-v10 diff leaves this sentence byte-identical even though v10 deleted the exactly-at member.

$.basedOn.leftoverJoinV13.role changes only the speaker from v9 to v10 and still says 'g21-fixture-corpus.v10 authors those two as quoted prefix-only files.' In context, 'those two' expressly refers to prefix exactly at the operative bound and prefix far over the operative bound.

The latter recital directly contradicts the repaired accounting surfaces: $.whatIsNotAuthored retains prefix exactly at and the postHandshake far-over half, while $.remainderAfterThisCorpus says N=65536 is not pinned as RF-2 and only one preHandshake far-over witness is authored.
shouldFix.impact: A recorded successor would contain two false present-tense authoring recitals in pinned lineage metadata. A later reader or remainder remasurement could cite those clauses as evidence that the exactly-at entry was authored, undoing the honesty of the otherwise-correct catalog and remainder repair. The contradiction is material enough that the candidate should not be accepted with it present.
shouldFix.whyNotMustFix: The false count is confined to two explanatory basedOn role strings. No fixture byte, catalog member, digest, expected fate, remainder bit, closure bit, readiness token, or authority boundary relies on the count: every operative top-level surface correctly withdraws the exactly-at member and preserves the remaining work. This is therefore a current-standing consistency and honesty defect rather than a corrupt payload or remainder measurement.
shouldFix.requiredRemedy: In a frozen successor, make both roles describe one quoted preHandshake far-over witness. Remove the D-293 role's count of two, and make the leftover-join role say that v10 authors only the far-over preHandshake witness while exactly-at and the postHandshake far-over half remain unauthored. Preserve this frozen subject, v9, and all fixtures unchanged.
